title: event-shipper has been 'starting up' forever and telemetry is dark
description_md:
`event-shipper` is supposed to be forwarding a steady stream of events, but nothing has shown up in the telemetry pipeline since the box came up. It's not crash-looping, it's not spinning a CPU, and it isn't a zombie -- `ps` shows it just sitting there, alive, doing nothing, apparently forever. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out exactly what it's stuck waiting on, and get the pipeline flowing.

You're done when events are actually being collected end-to-end.
